instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, this instance covers an online instructional-design microcredential run by a university continuing-education unit, with virtual seminars, design studios, peer critiques, and portfolio review.
Scope: Recurring areas include module study, learning-objective writing, storyboard work, accessibility checks, learning-technology exercises, peer feedback, capstone portfolio assembly, badge requirements, advising, and education expenses.
Resources: Reusable records track learner-owned design items, scheduled program activities, and credential milestones; blank files support design notes, portfolio drafting, and communications; a personal wallet handles authorized costs.
Exclusions: It excludes paid training deliverables, employer systems, instructor grading authority, classmates’ private data, official university records, and casual software use without program requirements.
personal_description:
Identity: Rowan Celeste Ibarra is an adult learner enrolled throughout 2026 in a structured instructional-design microcredential through a university continuing-education program.
Responsibilities: She manages weekly readings, design-studio preparation, storyboard drafts, accessibility evidence, technology-practice artifacts, peer-review obligations, capstone portfolio materials, advising follow-up, and personal education spending.
Authority: Rowan may organize her own learning records, draft and revise her submissions, request permitted student support, communicate with faculty and peers, and purchase approved learning tools or materials.
Restrictions: She cannot change official grades, issue credentials, represent university approval, commit peers to group decisions, access restricted course systems, or submit employer-owned content as personal coursework.
